# Project Templates

Project templates are intentionally small JSON definitions that can be copied
into a portable bundle and extended with project-specific documents.

| Template | Intended data |
| --- | --- |
| `survey.json` | cross-sectional survey preparation and scales |
| `experiment.json` | treatment, outcome, and reproducible analysis |
| `repeated-measures.json` | subject/time observations |
| `operational.json` | operational records with identifiers and weights |
| `dyadic.json` | partner-role observations and APIM-compatible analyses |

Templates describe contracts and document references only; they never embed
user data or credentials.
